method: Every snapshot (each record = {captured_at, market{...}, series_ticker, family}) was read with a script; counts are exact over those 105 files, not sampled, except where noted.

findings.cadence: 105 snapshots over 30 calendar days, 2-4 per day (not continuous quote history)

settlement.note: Results arrive from the market record itself (status=finalized), first seen at the next snapshot after settlement; the 2 scalar results must not be read as YES/NO. In the latest snapshot 5,512 of 19,559 records were finalized with result/settlement_value/settlement_ts populated on 100% of them.

prices_volume_oi.price_history_note: price fields are populated on every record, but only 942 of 19,670 tickers changed last_price between the first, middle and last snapshot (most contracts are illiquid)

findings.orderbook: the archive record has an `orderbook` key but it is null on the latest snapshot's first record; depth was not field-checked across files
limits: time resolution is hours, so no intraday path or closing-line-at-tip-off; the pregame price at a given time is only the latest snapshot before it
settlement timestamp is the exchange's; the capture time of the final row is a LATER bound on when the result was known to us
